The quality target Our goal is to send out enough legendary tasks to make sure that all our Papers and Tasks are perfect quality - you have check the difference and start rating to understand the difference - learn from the best and apply to everything

Strategic direction

Freeze every currently published Paper and Task as a revision-pinned unit; compare each unit against the best verified examples; rate it with one measurable class-specific rubric; prove reader behavior across Studio, TUI, email, public, and CLI/API; repair only after Experiment selects and seals a reproducible format; and stop only when every frozen unit has one truthful outcome.

  • Keep Paper and Task identities class-prefixed because authoring-excellence, preview-contract, and theme-system exist in both classes.
  • Never silently resume or mutate historical wave legendary-paper-task-quality-takeover-2026-07-15; it remains immutable, unsealed, and blocked before Survey at 0/135.
